company.name: Bus14
company.shortDescription: Bus14 provides AI-powered school transportation in MENA, combining safety, flexible payments, and 24/7 support for families and schools
company.description:
Bus14 is an Egyptian student transportation platform that leverages AI and a flexible payment system to deliver safe, convenient, and reliable school rides.
The service is designed for families, schools, and companies, combining advanced tracking, 24/7 customer support, and a loyalty program that offers medical discounts and cashback. Unlike traditional school buses and ride-hailing apps, Bus14 prioritizes service continuity, safety, and customer satisfaction. Operating across East Cairo, Bus14 has built strong partnerships and a track record of never missing a trip in 3 years.
